text: ana-design: quick design check for retention modal + region selector + encryption indicator. attaching figma + screenshots. need: non-misleading key copy, CSV header names, keyboard focus for badges. TL;DR in thread. ryan-eng: Quick Q — for org accounts do we honor an org-wide default region on first render? or use last chosen by user? samantha-pm: Product decision: show org default top-of-list with a small tag 'Org default' and let users save overrides. If no org default, show 'Fallback: Global' in muted text. morgan-copy: Microcopy proposals (short, prefer scannable): - Option 1: "Retention period — 60 days (storage region: us-east-1)" - Option 2: "Data retained for 60 days. Storage region: us-east-1." - Option 3: "Retention: 60 days — stored in us-east-1" I like Option 1 for label clarity. tess-a11y: Accessibility nits: the encryption badge is currently decorative and not reachable by keyboard. We need the badge to be focusable and announced. Don't use role=img. Provide both a short accessible name and a longer description via aria-describedby. Also ensure the fallback text contrast meets 4.5:1. harry-legal: Legal check: avoid saying we 'store' customer keys. Use phrasing like 'managed by your KMS' or 'under your KMS' and never display ARNs or key IDs in tooltips. ryan-eng: Implementation note: CSV currently exports region_id and retention_policy_id. We'll map to human headers: 'Storage region' and 'Retention policy'. For encryption column use 'Encryption' with values 'Platform-managed' or 'Customer-managed (KMS region: us-east-1)'. Backend will translate region slugs to human-readable region names. morgan-copy: For on-screen badge keep it short: 'Customer-managed' / 'Platform-managed'. Tooltip (longer): 'Customer-managed encryption key (managed by your KMS, region: us-east-1).' Harry OK with that? harry-legal: That's fine; prefer replacing 'key' with 'encryption key' in hover copy. Also ensure we don't imply custody. Final suggested tooltip: 'Customer-managed encryption key (managed by your KMS, region: us-east-1).' tess-a11y: Example implementation snippet for devs (avoid role=img): ``` Customer-managed Encryption type Customer-managed encryption key, managed by your KMS, region: us-east-1 ``` This gives SR users the short label and the longer description. Make sure focus ring is visible (2px) and color has enough contrast. ana-design: small visual ask: add a subtle shield icon to the left of the badge (not a full lock) and keep badge background slightly lighter so the label contrasts more. If org default is unset show tiny 'Fallback: Global' under the region picker. ryan-eng: Also note mobile tooltip length — keep mobile text concise. For SR fallback we can use aria-label=\"Encryption: Customer-managed, region: us-east-1\" in addition to the sr-only description for verbose contexts. samantha-pm: CSV UX question: do we include encryption detail in the CSV? I vote yes. Column name 'Encryption' with values 'Platform-managed' / 'Customer-managed (KMS region: us-east-1)'. This helps ops correlate events. harry-legal: OK as long as we don't display PII or key identifiers. Use region only. morgan-copy: Also suggest making the retention label read 'Retention period' with hint text 'How long user data is kept before deletion.' Keeps wording consistent with other console pages. tess-a11y: Keyboard order should be: region picker -> retention dropdown -> encryption badge -> help link. Add aria-live region for dynamic fallback notices if the org default changes while the modal is open. deploy-bot: Staging build deployed: 2026-03-24T02:15:09 — https://staging.redwood.ai/console/retention — accessibility snapshot attached. ryan-eng: I'll add unit tests to assert CSV header mapping and that export contains human-readable region names. Tagging @tess-a11y for SR QA when staging is live. ana-design: I'll push updated figma with the Option 1 copy, add the shield icon, and annotate the sr-only nodes. Will ping thread when ready for review. :sparkles:
